gaps.evidence: The JD requires HubSpot for campaign management and lead scoring. The CV shows no HubSpot experience at all.
gaps.suggestion: Ask the candidate about any marketing automation or CRM tools used in prior roles, and whether HubSpot has come up in training or side projects.

gaps.evidence: The JD asks for A/B testing on landing pages with a clear methodology. The CV describes landing page work but no experimentation.
gaps.suggestion: Ask whether the candidate has run experiments on landing pages and, if so, how they defined success and called winners.

gaps.evidence: Paid acquisition on LinkedIn Ads is required alongside Google Ads. The CV only shows Google Ads.
gaps.suggestion: Ask if the candidate has run paid LinkedIn campaigns at any budget, or supported a colleague who did.
